scope: Add whole-operation allocation rollback, same-codec retry, and typed readback coverage for the three non-2D classic POLYLINE topologies across representative DXF version boundaries.

source.kind: deterministic locally-authored records generated during each test run
profiles: closed 2x2 POLYGONMESH with four WCS vertices
POLYFACE mesh with four coordinate vertices and one indexed face record

implementation.method: For each profile/version/encoding, calibrate a complete dxfRW::write, inject std::bad_alloc at every reached allocation, require destination sentinel and caller-owned source records to remain unchanged, then retry with the same codec and require byte-identical output plus fresh typed readback of parent topology, coordinates, and polyface indices.

limitations: Generated DXF transport and transaction evidence only; producer interoperability and native consumer semantics are not qualified.
The polygon mesh is a 2x2 closed-N grid; broader mesh densities and spline-fit variants remain outside this slice.
The polyface control has one four-index face; additional face winding, invisible-edge, and richer XDATA profiles remain open.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.

planImpact.completedSlice: 3D POLYLINE, POLYGONMESH, and POLYFACE whole-operation ASCII/Binary allocation rollback, same-codec retry, and typed readback for AC1014, AC1021, AC1024, and AC1032.
planImpact.remainingP6G: Continue auditing distinct public-writer overloads, unrepresented compound-record variants, and variable-size OBJECTS profiles; retain producer and semantic gates.
